# Project structure

Generated by `scripts/gen_structure.py`; do not hand-edit.

**Real root:** `/Users/brianoregan/hrsd`

**Also reachable as:** `/Users/brianoregan/Desktop/HRSD_Occupants` — a symlink to `/Users/brianoregan/hrsd`.

The tree was moved out of `~/Desktop` because macOS TCC denies launchd access to it, which made the LaunchAgent exit 126 (I-107); granting Full Disk Access was explicitly not wanted. A symlink was left at the old path so every absolute path already written into the repo keeps resolving — and 66 symlinks inside this tree still point at the old path, so **removing that symlink would break them**. They are listed below with their targets.

## What is collapsed, and why

Everything in this tree is listed in full except two subtrees:

- **`.git`** — version-control internals: object files named by content hash. They describe git's storage, not this project.
- **`scripts/.venv`** — the Python virtualenv, i.e. third-party packages from PyPI. Not project structure, and the single largest contributor to the path count.

Nothing else is omitted. Every generated artefact, every checkpoint and every superseded directory is listed, because which generated files exist is itself part of what the tree records about the run.
